fields.note: No commercial external-pressure chamber found takes a 5-6 m article; the largest found are 2.3 m ID (FET), 1.6 m (Matrix) and Tyne's TPT5 (4.5 m long). The rig is therefore evacuation under the cap plus a water head above it. The hydrostatic gradient over the 0.32-0.46 m rise is 3.1-4.5 kPa (about 3% at 120 kPa), and the pole sees the lowest pressure. Collapse dynamics under water and tank safety are open.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
